## Full-Stack Development

### Frontend Technologies

#### React Ecosystem
- **Core**: React 18+, Hooks, Context API
- **State Management**: Redux, Redux Toolkit, Zustand
- **Routing**: React Router v6
- **Form Handling**: React Hook Form, Formik
- **HTTP Client**: Axios, Fetch API
- **Testing**: Jest, React Testing Library, Vitest
- **Build Tools**: Webpack, Vite, Parcel
- **UI Libraries**: Material-UI, Tailwind CSS, Styled Components

#### Vue & Angular
- Vue 3, Composition API
- Angular 15+, RxJS
- Component architecture
- State management with Pinia, NgRx

### Backend Technologies

#### Node.js & Express
- **Express.js**: REST APIs, middleware, authentication
- **Server Setup**: Nginx, Apache
- **Session Management**: JWT, OAuth 2.0, Passport.js
- **Real-time**: WebSockets, Socket.io
- **Testing**: Mocha, Chai, Jest

#### Python Backend
- **Django**: Full-stack framework, ORM
- **FastAPI**: Modern async framework
- **Flask**: Lightweight microframework
- **APIs**: RESTful, GraphQL with graphene
- **Testing**: Pytest, Unittest

### Database Management

#### Relational Databases
- **PostgreSQL**: Advanced queries, indexing, optimization
- **MySQL**: InnoDB, transactions, replication
- **SQL**: Complex queries, CTEs, window functions

#### NoSQL Databases
- **MongoDB**: Document design, aggregation pipeline
- **Redis**: Caching, sessions, pub/sub
- **Elasticsearch**: Full-text search, analytics

### API Design
- RESTful principles and best practices
- GraphQL schema design and optimization
- API versioning and deprecation strategies
- Rate limiting and throttling
- Documentation (Swagger/OpenAPI)
